result.within_thread_count_determinism: confirmed — every repeated rep at the same thread count reproduces last_loss bit-for-bit (t1: 2/2, t2: 2/2, t4: 2/2)
result.across_thread_count_determinism: REFUTED — last_loss takes exactly two distinct values, bucketed by thread count: {1,2} -> 32.61008071899414; {3,4} -> 32.610084533691406
result.note: delta is float32-precision-scale (~4e-6 absolute, ~1.2e-7 relative), consistent with non-associative floating-point reduction order changing with thread count (a known torch/BLAS CPU behavior), not a bug — but real, measured, and enough to make a bit-for-bit cross-session last_loss comparison meaningless unless thread count is pinned and recorded.

scope_caveat: Does not reproduce or explain the specific s36_seed42 discrepancy from lever-seed-robustness-s36-asap-t30-measured-results.md — that used a different (undocumented, no committed reproducible command) exposure12/ASAP/decode_timeout=30 SFT+eval recipe, not wf_smoke_v2.
